title: The pamphlet nobody wanted to make

hero.concept: A thin stapled company pamphlet rests on the dark grid desk with its masthead box visible. It builds into a real publication: cover rows print, a second spread fans out behind it, a mailing-list stack and a production checklist appear, and the checklist then goes stale and overdue.

content.cover_sub: Vol. 1 · No. 1 · for our dealers & buyers

sections.supporting: Group A (w9-21): pamphlet, page-count chip and a thin paper shadow. Group B (w26-38): back spread fanned at 6°, mailing-label stack at bottom-left, address counter chip at top-right. Group C (w47-54): checklist card at the right edge, a red strike on the due date, and the overdue chip. A faint coffee-ring stain and a stapler outline sit as quiet foreground props.
sections.camera: Locked through the hook. Hero beat: a slow 6% push toward the masthead box runs from w47 to w54, then holds.
sections.transition_out: While the speaker is full-screen (w66-75), the camera pulls back. When the panel returns on w76, the same pamphlet is a small cover thumbnail sitting in slot 1 of a 12-slot issue shelf. It is a match cut on the cover art.

hero.concept: A wall shelf of twelve monthly slots, with only slot 1 holding a cover. The other slots dim to dashed outlines. A price tag lands on the one real issue, then a loupe settles over it and reveals what is inside.

sections.supporting: Group A (w76-83): the slot row outlines draw one after another, the 'No. 1' stamp lands, and a counter chip appears top-right. Group B (w108-112): a price tag card lands on slot 1, the price counter ticks up, and a thin red underline appears. Group C (w114-121): a loupe ring with a fine scale, magnified ad rows, and yellow highlighter ticks. The shelf edge and its shadow stay as a constant midground line.
sections.camera: Hero beat: a slow push into slot 1 starts on w114 and lands on w121, framing the loupe.
sections.transition_out: The loupe view of slot 1 keeps scaling until its magnified page fills the panel. When the panel returns after the speaker run (w153), that page is the opened pamphlet document of the next section.

hero.concept: The opened pamphlet page sits on light grid paper. Each row is marked as a sales row, yellow for promos and red for order or price calls-to-action, until the whole page reads as a catalogue. In the margin, the editor's blue-pen notes hint at a different magazine.

rows.text: NEW THIS MONTH — 14 titles in stock

sections.supporting: Group A (w153-158): two avatar chips pair up top-right, joined by a thin connector line. Group B (w162-177): highlighter strokes, with small row-number ticks in the gutter. Group C (w181-182): tally chip, ratio bar and a red edge rule. The blue margin notes write on in their own hand, so the page is never alone.
sections.camera: Locked. A gentle 2° tilt toward the page happens once on w158, then holds.
sections.transition_out: The red order-form row lifts off the page. Its ruled lines stretch into the signature block of a publishing agreement, a match cut from form lines to contract lines, revealed when the panel returns on w205.

hero.concept: A dark contract card with thin white borders. A funding row fills, an equity bar splits into three equal segments, and three signature lines are inked one at a time, with the last one named.

sections.supporting: Group A (w205-212): agreement title, funding row and a fill bar with a small currency chip. Group B (w217-220): the equity bar's three segments, each with a percentage label. Group C (w221-230): ink strokes on the signature lines, an 'Al' avatar chip and a grey pending stamp. The thin clause lines stay visible as midground texture.
sections.camera: Hero beat: a slow upward tilt from the equity bar to the signature block runs w217-220.
sections.transition_out: The camera pushes into the clause area of the agreement. Its ruled clause lines lift and re-set as the numbered rows of an editorial charter. The rows start blurred and the gold light cools.

hero.concept: A numbered editorial charter whose blurred rows unblur one by one, then lock on a red independence row. Below it, a page layout builds three equal-width bylined cards, measured by a ruler to show that no one gets more space.

rows: 01 Honest reviews — every program, every publisher
content.locked_row: 06 — favors no publisher, including the backers

sections.supporting: Group A (w246-255): blurred rows, row-number ticks and an unblur shimmer along each row. Group B (w275-280): red highlight box on row 06, a red underline and a struck logo chip. Group C (w281-295): three byline cards, byline avatar chips and the ruler with equal-width labels. The charter, the cards and the ruler are always on screen together.
sections.camera: Hero beat 1: a push into row 06 from w275 to w280. Hero beat 2: an eased pull-back that reveals the charter and the page layout together, from w293 to w295, then hold. The speaker takes the final line.
sections.transition_out: End of reel. The pulled-back charter holds under the final full-screen speaker run (w296-301).
